criteria.title: Personality spec maps to OpenClaw prompt sections
criteria.assertion: SoulPersonaSpec traits, style, tone, constraints, and system_prompt_sections are normalized and mapped into canonical OpenClaw role, guidelines, and red_lines sections.
criteria.expected_result: Explicit role/guidelines/red_lines content is preserved, traits/style/tone are appended to guidelines, and constraints are appended to red_lines.

criteria.title: Composite system prompt assembly is deterministic
criteria.assertion: The personality service assembles a composite system prompt from canonical sections in role, guidelines, red_lines order and omits empty sections.
criteria.expected_result: The assembled prompt uses stable section headers and ordering for reproducible runtime updates.

criteria.title: Persona fields are validated before runtime dispatch
criteria.assertion: Invalid persona traits, constraints, section names, duplicates, and disallowed control characters are rejected before building runtime params.
criteria.expected_result: Malformed persona specs return validation errors and do not produce runtime control params.

criteria.title: Persona update runtime params contract is defined
criteria.assertion: Bahia defines the soulfactory.persona.update method and the soulfactory-persona/v1 params payload for kind 38384 runtime control requests.
criteria.expected_result: Runtime params include normalized persona data plus OpenClaw system_prompt_sections and system_prompt_override fields using snake_case wire names; agent_defaults_patch carries OpenClaw-native config keys such as systemPromptOverride.
